about: A fermenter on two by two cells, 1.8 m to the top of its sight glass: a steel vessel with a conical bottom and an orange band, hung in a yellow frame over a steel deck plate, a cabinet on its west with a run lamp and a fault lamp on its controls and a status lamp on its top, a gooseneck vent and a sight glass on its dome filling with what it has brewed, a tap under the cone.
